name: The Lockdown of Shinisou Elementary
source:
A normal day at Shinisou Elementary takes a sinister turn at the appearance of a stranger.

What does this man want?

The only clue we have is his cryptic statement: “I wonder what kind of performance this school has for me…”

[From [url=http://twinturtlegames.com/games/shinisou-elementary/]Twin Turtle Games[/url]]
